paper_reference: Farhangdoost et al., 2024. AKAP11 heterozygous LOF in human iPSC-derived cortical neurons (GSE263850), hg38.

dmr.dss_equivalent: DSS::callDMR(p.threshold=1e-5, delta=0, minlen=50, minCG=3, dis.merge=100, pct.sig=0.5)

gene_linkage_100kb.rule: Include every gene whose canonical TSS lies within 100 kb of the DMR midpoint (paper's exact rule). Multiple genes per DMR allowed; one row per (DMR, gene) pair.
gene_linkage_100kb.tss_source: UCSC refGene.txt.gz, one canonical TSS per gene per chromosome (most-upstream on strand).
